entries.zh: 存养；保养天然本性（存心养性）
entries.en: to preserve one's natural virtue / innate nature; to nurture one's moral disposition

entries.zh: 鉴；鉴察、鉴别（考虑并判断）
entries.en: to examine and judge; to consider, to weigh

entries.zh: 根据；考虑、据理推测（汉字有异文之疑）
entries.en: to consider; to conjecture on the basis (of evidence)
entries.notes: 汉字栏标[疑:據/鄈]，且西语 g./o 缩写待定，故降 medium。

entries.zh: 共伊解忧闷；替他排解忧愁烦闷、安慰他（原件有污损）
entries.en: to relieve his sorrows and gloom, to comfort him
entries.notes: 音写与官话栏均含 T99 污损难辨记号，释义取汉字四字串直接训读。

entries.zh: 慰服；安慰使其心服（第二音节栏有污损）
entries.en: to console so as to pacify; to comfort into acceptance
entries.notes: 闽南语栏第二字标 T99 污损，'服'字释义存疑。

entries.en: to comfort the heart; to set one's mind at ease

entries.zh: 落音；声音相谐合韵（押韵）
entries.en: to rhyme (voices falling together); consonance of sounds
to fall in tune; to accord in tone (consonance of voices)

entries.zh: 诗韵；诗之韵（西语谓音当相协）
entries.en: the rhymes of poetry; metrical rhyme scheme

entries.zh: 做守；坚守所决（决心不移，汉字有异文之疑）
entries.en: steadfastness in one's resolve; to hold to a determination
entries.notes: 汉字栏标[疑:做/倣]，缩写展开依赖推断，降 medium。

entries.zh: 有定；恒定不变、确然之事
entries.en: a constant thing; fixed and unchanging

entries.zh: 烈；刚烈、猛烈（西语词头疑有转录讹误）
entries.notes: 西语词头 'constante usa' 疑为抄录讹误，与'烈'字对应关系靠上下文推断，降 medium。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（'片僻'或谓偏僻固执）
entries.en: 〔damaged in the original, gloss uncertain〕 (p'ien-p'hek: perverse, biased, obstinate?)
entries.notes: 音写栏标[残]且多 T99，西语词头 'constancia enborcasay' 不可解。

entries.zh: 胶固；固守不放手、坚持到底（不收手）
entries.en: tenacity, holding fast and not letting go; obstinate persistence
